data.narrative:
Solar Foods is a public-stage biotech company that has raised over $160M to date. The valuation analysis relies on a peer-median approach applied across three same-sector, same-stage comparables in Biotech & Health: Recursion Pharmaceuticals ($1.6B), Freenome ($1.1B), and Alto Neuroscience ($1.0B).

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach here, yielding a median implied valuation of $1.1B. The three-company peer set ranges from $1.0B to $1.6B, establishing a distribution around the median. A public-comp anchoring approach using price-to-sales multiples from three public biotech tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) with a median sector P/S of 6.6x cannot be applied because Solar Foods' revenue is not disclosed, which is typical for private or early-public stage companies.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $935M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a central estimate of $1.1B. The primary uncertainty stems from limited methodological coverage — only one quantitative method is applicable — and the absence of company-specific financial metrics to calibrate multiples. The peer set, while same-sector and same-stage, may vary materially in stage of commercialization, capital efficiency, and time-to-revenue, factors not captured in this valuation approach.
